extra_vocab.en: a promise that makes someone feel sure that something will happen
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 Mr. Reed 問 What assurance can you give us，意思是「你能給我們什麼保證」，希望對方提出具體的擔保，讓議員放心工程不會再停擺。語氣禮貌但帶有質疑。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: assurance 表示「保證」時是可數名詞（an assurance、assurances），後面接 that 子句或 of；表示「自信」時是不可數名詞。

example.en: The supplier gave us several assurances about the delivery schedule.
example.zh: 供應商就交貨時程向我們做了好幾項保證。

example.en: Can you give an assurance that the costs will not rise?
example.zh: 你能保證成本不會上漲嗎？

example.en: The client asked for written assurance before signing the contract.
example.zh: 客戶在簽約前要求書面保證。

example.en: Investors sought assurance that the project would stay on budget.
example.zh: 投資人尋求專案不會超出預算的保證。

example.en: The quality assurance team tests every product before it ships.
example.zh: 品質保證團隊在每項產品出貨前都會測試。

examples.en: The manager offered his assurance that the report would be ready.
examples.zh: 經理保證報告會準備好。

examples.en: We need your assurance that the repairs will finish by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們需要你保證維修會在星期五前完成。

examples.en: Without clear assurance from the bank, the board refused to proceed.
examples.zh: 沒有銀行明確的保證，董事會拒絕繼續進行。

confusable.diff: insurance 是「保險」，assurance 是「口頭或書面的保證」，兩字拼法和發音很像。

example.en: The company bought insurance to cover damage during shipping.
example.zh: 公司購買保險以涵蓋運送途中的損壞。

similar.diff: guarantee 更正式，常有合約或保固的約束力；assurance 是讓對方放心的說法。

example.en: The contract includes a guarantee that work will finish on time.
example.zh: 合約中包含工程會準時完成的保證。

similar.diff: commitment 強調「承諾去做」，assurance 強調「讓對方確信」。

example.en: The mayor made a strong commitment to complete the project.
example.zh: 市長強力承諾會完成這項計畫。

example.en: Strong sales results gave investors more confidence in the firm.
example.zh: 強勁的銷售成績讓投資人對公司更有信心。

example.en: We cannot say with certainty when the work will finish.
example.zh: 我們無法確定工程何時會完成。

example.en: The company made a pledge to reduce its waste.
example.zh: 公司承諾要減少廢棄物。

derived.link: assurance 的詞幹，assure 是「保證」；去掉 -ance 就是動詞，像 insure → insurance
re-（再次）+ assure，再保證一次，像 rebuild、restart

senses.en: a promise that something will happen or is true
senses.distinguish: 常和 give、seek 一起用，後面接 that 子句。

example.en: The contractor gave us his assurance that the roof was safe.
example.zh: 承包商向我們保證屋頂是安全的。

senses.en: a feeling of being sure about yourself
senses.distinguish: 不可數，常用 with assurance 或 self-assurance 表示態度。

example.en: She spoke with assurance during the investor presentation.
example.zh: 她在投資人簡報中說話很有自信。
